title: Python Lazy Exception Stack
objective: Defer JavaScript exception stack formatting until diagnostics or introspection consumes it without losing captured frames

runs.command: node --test --test-name-pattern=stacks format|surfaced exceptions|exception repr|parser|compiler|timing|runtime source|cause/context|branching chains|attaching|worker serialization test/lazy-exception-stack.cjs test/exception-repr.cjs test/python-diagnostics.cjs
pnpm dlx node@22.22.2 --test --test-name-pattern=stacks format|surfaced exceptions|exception repr test/lazy-exception-stack.cjs test/exception-repr.cjs

handoff.summary: Capture native errors eagerly but defer stack formatting through shared accessors and a private WeakMap. Preserve capture-time headers/frames, writable overrides, sealed/frozen observation, subclass stack setters, and surfaced worker diagnostics. Diagnostic baselib rebuild only: selected 15 tests pass on Node 26; selected 6 pass on Node 22.22.2; strict checks pass for 385 modules. The full 17-test command retains two failures from the independently reproduced baseline raise-from cause/suppression bug; no assertion is weakened.
risks: Not integration-qualified: the exact broad oracle is blocked by the separate raise-from prerequisite, and a full combined build/corpus run remains required.
Adds 2405 raw errors.py source bytes beyond the separate repr prerequisite; the integration source budget must pass without widening thresholds.

Before first observation the stack is an enumerable/configurable accessor, becoming the prior writable data property on read or assignment. Native error capture is retained; only formatting is deferred.
End-to-end performance and four-platform qualification remain pending. Local mechanism timing is not an acceptance benchmark.
next_steps: Integrate repr prerequisite c630670cb and the separately assigned raise-from correction, retaining all exact oracle assertions.
Retain the integration branch's positional-default helper when merging errors.py.
Run the full combined build, complete focused suite, original corpus, source budgets, and controlled representative performance campaign before readiness.
